notes.subject: עלי
notes.rationale: 'bɛ ne kan' (walima 'bɛ ne ye') — YLT kɔrɔfɔli 'upon me' ɲɛfɔla de ye; KJV fana b'o ye 'toward me' ye.

notes.subject: ⟨את⟩
notes.rationale: Taamasiyɛn ⟨את⟩ min bɛ sira sanfɛ, a ma bayɛlɛma Heburu kɔnɔ — a ye ɲɛfɔli jiralan ye (verse in tɔgɔdilen ye).

notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ Yawe wele ni ɲɛkɔrɔ ye — galon weleli (petition), masa tɔgɔ la.

translation: Mah bɛ se ka segin Yawe ma, nin ⟨את⟩ a ka tagemulow bɛɛ bɛ ne ye? — ni a sɔrɔ a ka tagemulow bɛɛ bɛ ne kan.
